use_in_main_text: Two evidence paragraphs; distinguish STB-dominated selected experiments from mixed foliar-disease annual gaps.
figure_role: One supplementary observational yield-context figure, independent of model-performance figures.
legitimate_novel_result: Exact 22-year official annual distribution and disease-attribution audit; descriptive synthesis, not new meta-analysis.
inventory_scope: 17 targeted primary/archived source records; not an exhaustive systematic review and not 17 independent studies.
avoid: Pooling Garnault2004–2017 and Performance2004–2025 as independent studies
Calling mixed foliar-disease fungicide gains pure STB loss
Using BLUP prediction errors as independent sampling SEs
Pooling incompatible ordinal scores, leaf ranks or thermal/calendar HAD slopes
Converting normalized affected-tissue days to grain-yield percentages or tonnage
Interpreting published yearly variation as climate causation
data_needed_for_new_meta_analysis: Protected and untreated yield means and n
Paired-difference variance, or replicate/block yields and shared-control covariance
STB plus other pathogen severity and control efficacy
Leaf area/rank, assessment timing and phenology
Source identifiers sufficient to remove overlapping experiments

priorities.target: 2004–2017 rust-resistant STB-susceptible paired raw trial yields and variance
161 crop-pair dataset, plot replicates and overlap map
147-line field dataset; explicit reasonable-request availability; author contact not initiated

source_conflicts.resolution: Source trial memberships and retrospective revisions are unavailable, so the discrepancy is unresolved. Retain the retrospective Performance series without splicing or averaging the two summaries.
